title: Crüger to Müller, Palm Sunday 1628
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller of Palm Sunday 1628, written at Danzig after he had seen the *Rudolphine Tables* announced in the Frankfurt fair catalogue. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. M. 34). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 108.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Having seen the *Rudolphine Tables* announced in the Frankfurt catalogue, Crüger orders a copy and confesses a great longing for them.

notes.on: the more uncertain Severin leaves me
notes.note: Longomontanus, whose *Astronomia Danica* (1622) Crüger had hoped would settle the matter.
